d: The Trail Blazers defeated the 76ers, 128-111 tonight in Philadelphia. Deni Avdija contributed a team-high 31 points to go with 7 assists 5 three pointers and 3 rebounds, with Jrue Holiday of the Trail Blazers adding an additional 18 points (7-13 FG, 4-5 3P) in the game. LeBron James finished with a team-high 23 points along with 6 rebounds for the 76ers in the losing effort. The Trail Blazers improve their record to 11-6 with the win, while the 76ers fall to 14-4 for the season.
